name: cardzen
description: Look up documented card benefits and Cardzen-tracked credit activity

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Cardzen wallet to compare documented card benefits and see which credits expire this month. Expiration lookups show the credit name, card name, and date. Recorded usage, remaining amounts, and upcoming renewals depend on account access. No bank linking or card numbers are required.

Cardzen uses your saved wallet and card catalog. Check with your issuer for official balances and terms. Features depend on your plan and permissions. Cardzen changes your wallet or credit tracking only when you ask and grant permission. Cardzen cannot apply for cards, move money, or pay bills.
defaultPrompt: Which cards are in my Cardzen wallet?
Compare the travel benefits on the cards in my Cardzen wallet.
Which credits on my credit cards expire this month?

positive.prompt: Which cards are in my Cardzen wallet?
positive.expected_behavior: List only the connected sample account’s cards. Do not show full card numbers or another account’s data.

positive.prompt: Show my upcoming annual fees and renewal dates.
positive.expected_behavior: For the prepared American Express Gold sample with open date January 15, 2026, show the stored anniversary and $325 annual fee. No issuer account action.

positive.description: Read credit expiration dates for the current Eastern month.
positive.prompt: Which credits on my credit cards expire this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_expiring_credits with calendar_month=true. Show the card name, credit name, and expiration date for the connected sample. Free returns only these three fields. The Pro review fixture can return tracked amounts in the tool result. Keep the answer focused on names and dates. Report an empty result if the current sample has no qualifying credit.

positive.prompt: Find currently open travel cards with no annual fee.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded catalog matches for the requested filters, or truthfully report none. Do not apply for a card.

positive.description: Update one explicitly requested sample credit period.
positive.prompt: This is a dedicated synthetic reviewer account. I authorize updating only its Cardzen credit tracking record: set October 2026 American Express Gold Dunkin’ Credit to used with $7 used. This records usage in Cardzen and does not make a purchase or payment. Please perform the supported set_credit_usage action.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact owned credit and period 10 of 2026. Use the host’s applicable write permission flow and update only that Cardzen tracking record after the explicit request. Report the actual tool outcome. A separate stored-history read must confirm $7 used. Restore the synthetic sample to unused with $0 used and verify it with a separate read. Do not make purchases or payments. Do not claim a separate confirmation dialog if the host does not show one.

negative.prompt: Apply for a new card and pay my bill.
Write a cover letter for a software engineering job.

review.commerce_description: This connection does not sell products, apply for credit cards, process payments, or transfer money.

publication.release_notes: Wallet Actions can record different usage values for several explicitly requested periods of one credit in a single update, with saved Start Date validation.
